title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks: Architectures, Trainability, and Applications
abstract: arXiv:2611.17886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum graph neural networks (QGNNs) apply parametrized quantum circuits to graph-structured data, with the aim of overcoming limits of classical graph neural networks in scalability, expressivity, and long-range information flow. Since the first Hamiltonian-based model in 2019, the field has produced many architectures, applications, and claims, but the evidence behind them has not been assessed systematically. This survey introduces a unified formalism that describes every QGNN as an encoder, a graph-conditioned circuit, observables, and an optional classical head, together with a circuit-level condition for permutation equivariance and a resource model for comparing costs. We organize the literature into five architecture families (convolutional, equivariant, message-passing and recurrent, Hamiltonian, and hybrid) and compare them by qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and evidence. We then review symmetry and geometric inductive bias

translated_title: 量子图神经网络：架构、可训练性与应用
translated_abstract: 量子图神经网络（QGNNs）将参数化量子电路应用于图结构数据，旨在克服经典图神经网络在可扩展性、表达能力以及长程信息流动方面的局限。自2019年首个基于哈密顿量的模型问世以来，该领域已涌现出众多架构、应用及相关论断，但其背后的证据尚未得到系统性评估。本综述引入了一个统一的形式化框架，将每个QGNN描述为编码器、图条件化量子电路、可观测量以及可选的经典后处理模块，并给出了置换等变性的电路级条件以及用于比较成本的资源模型。我们将相关文献归纳为五大架构家族（卷积型、等变型、消息传递与循环型、哈密顿型以及混合型），并从量子比特成本、对称性、可扩展性和证据强度等方面对其进行比较。随后，我们综述了对称性与几何归纳偏置等相关内容。
tldr: 本综述提出了描述量子图神经网络的统一形式化框架，将现有文献归纳为五大架构家族，并从量子比特成本、对称性、可扩展性和证据强度等方面对它们进行系统比较。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces a unified formalism for quantum graph neural networks, organizes the literature into five architecture families, and systematically compares them in terms of qubit cost, symmetry, scalability, and supporting evidence.
